full_prompt_en: A square cinematic collage portrait centers the face of a bespectacled man, with layered city scenes appearing inside and around his silhouette. The background is pale cream with a lightly aged, grainy surface, allowing the darker figure to feel partly printed onto paper. His thick dark hair spreads across the upper center in loose waves, its outline breaking into smoky marks near the top edge. Round glasses frame eyes that look slightly off to the side; the face is serious and still, modeled in muted ochre, charcoal, and gray-green rather than natural skin color. On the left of the head, a stack of older city buildings rises into the hair, with balconies, signs, and dark window openings compressed into a dense vertical strip. Below the face, numerous tiny figures occupy stairways and a crowded street, some silhouettes sharp and others fading into the paper. At the lower left, a separate standing figure in a gray coat anchors the collage at a smaller scale. The right side of the portrait thins into a pale open area, with a faint upright form near the lower edge. Architectural lines and human clusters blend through double-exposure-like transitions rather than strict cutout seams. Soft diffuse light keeps the cream field bright; darker shadows collect under the hair, inside windows, and among the small figures, giving the face and city layers depth without a single hard spotlight. Fine print grain and subdued color bind the different scales into one image. The overall composition balances a commanding, quiet face with dense urban fragments, creating a thoughtful and slightly uneasy visual rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影式拼贴肖像以一位戴眼镜男子的面孔为中心，层叠的城市景象出现在他的剪影内部和周围。背景是浅奶油色，带轻微陈旧的颗粒表面，使深色人物仿佛部分印在纸上。厚密黑发在上方中央松散起伏，轮廓到顶部边缘散成烟雾状线迹。圆眼镜框住略向一侧看的眼睛；面容严肃静止，以低调赭色、炭灰和灰绿塑造，而非自然肤色。头部左侧，一叠旧城市建筑向上进入头发，阳台、招牌和深色窗洞被压缩在密集竖带里。脸部下方，许多小人占据台阶与拥挤街道，一些剪影清晰，另一些淡入纸面。左下方，另有一个穿灰外套的站立人物，以更小的尺度锚定拼贴。肖像右侧逐渐变薄，进入浅色开阔区域，下缘附近只剩一道隐约的直立形。建筑线条和人群通过近似双重曝光的过渡相融，而不是严格的剪贴接缝。柔和漫射光保持奶油色底面明亮；深影聚于发下、窗内和小人群之间，让面孔与城市层次有纵深，却没有单一的硬聚光。细印刷颗粒与压低的色彩把不同尺度绑为一体。整体构图以有存在感而安静的面孔平衡密集城市碎片，形成沉思而略有不安的视觉节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image combines cinematic photographic modeling with layered graphic collage. Muted ochre, charcoal, gray-green, and aged cream dominate, and fine grain makes the layers feel printed into one surface. Large softly graded forms carry smaller, sharply detailed fragments that fade at their edges into mist and paper. Dense vertical clusters gather near one side of the focal mass, while the opposite side keeps pale breathing room. Diffuse light preserves subtle volume; the deepest darks are localized within overlapping recesses instead of coating the whole frame. Changes of scale and transparency create a reflective, uneasy mood within a controlled composition.
style_prompt_zh: 图像把电影式摄影塑形与层叠图形拼贴结合起来。低调赭色、炭灰、灰绿和陈旧奶油色占主导，细颗粒让各层仿佛印在同一表面。大面积柔和渐层形体承载更小、更锐利的细节碎片，碎片边缘逐渐淡入雾气和纸面。密集竖向簇群聚在焦点色块的一侧，对侧则保留浅色呼吸空间。漫射光保留细微体积；最深暗色局限在交叠凹处，而不铺满全幅。尺度与透明度的转换让受控构图带有沉思、不安的情绪。
theme_en: A contemplative bespectacled man merged with crowded urban scenes
theme_zh: 一位戴眼镜、神情沉思的男子与拥挤城市景象交融
name: Bong Joon Ho
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
